title: Group ordering occasion
question: Group ordering

decision.decision: Whether to build the spring campaign around group ordering

explanations.text: Buyers do not link us to group orders because we never show the occasion.
Buyers link group orders to a competitor so strongly that we cannot win it this year.

falsifier: If more than half of group-ordering buyers already link us to the occasion, the leading explanation is wrong.
stopping_rule: 300 completed category-buyer responses or December 15, whichever comes first.
repeating_unit: A category buyer who ordered for a group in the last 3 months
expected_result: Under a fifth of group-ordering buyers link us to the occasion.
